allowedChange: Add exactly one audience mapper to the existing dedicated csm-mobile scope; do not modify realm-wide/shared scopes or other mappers.
invariants: existing fullScopeAllowed true retained without expansion
no changes to roles or grants
cas: Immediately before saving re-read dedicated mapper list and verify empty/no matching mapper; do not overwrite existing mapper.
rollback: Only remove newly created mapper ID if name/provider/config still match the exact added mapper; preserve every other mapper and token policy.
validation: Fresh readback of saved mapper, original assigned scopes/capabilities/fullScopeAllowed; subsequent one owner-issued fresh login required. Old JWT is not rewritten.
